title: Check Punjab Free Livestock Scheme Status Online
excerpt: Learn how to check your selection status online for the Punjab Free Livestock Scheme's distribution of cows and buffaloes.
body_html:
The Punjab Livestock and Dairy Development Department has announced plans to start distributing free cows and buffaloes to selected applicants under its livestock scheme.

Online Verification

Residents who applied for the program can now check their selection status online through the designated system provided by the department.
